plain: The act of doing good or giving help to others

webster.text: The practice of doing good; active goodness, kindness, or charity.

example.quote: By adopting this system, the vigor and decision of a wide-spreading monarchy may be joined to the freedom and beneficence of a contracted republic.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, November 26, 1787 (2d ed. 1836)
